queries:
SELECT rating,
       r AS ratio,
       n AS film_count,
       r - AVG(r) OVER () AS diff_from_mean
FROM (
  SELECT rating,
         AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS r,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
);
SELECT rating, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) AS films, AVG(rental_rate), AVG(length), AVG(replacement_cost) FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY films DESC

SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS film_count
FROM film
WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND replacement_cost IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY rating;

SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS films
FROM film f
JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
GROUP BY f.rating;

SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS films, AVG(f.rental_rate), AVG(f.length), AVG(f.replacement_cost)
FROM film f
JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
GROUP BY f.rating
ORDER BY films DESC
SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS number_of_films FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating
